gates.meaning: The operation object is the environmental instrument at its own RS485 address. A direct child address and a gateway remap offset are distinct bindings.
The operation object is the attached meter. Use its established logical/RS485 address; this is not the gateway-self table.
These are gateway-supplied child-associated aliases, not proof that the child natively implements the same register map.
Public connection status: 0xB000 disconnected; 0xB001 online. This is separate from remapped inverter status 0xC000 uploading.
Device display name is limited to 20 bytes excluding the terminator, within visible ASCII 0x20–0x7E.

The legacy punctuation exclusion is printed as three adjacent glyphs: apostrophe (0x27), backslash (0x5C), double quote (0x22). The source does not separate list items or specify escape interpretation; retain that notation ambiguity.
